instruction: The SlugRegistry in slug.js is supposed to give every repeated title a unique slug by appending an incrementing suffix (-2, -3, -4, ...). Today claim() only ever tries the '-2' suffix, so the third repeat of a title is handed the same '-2' slug again — a duplicate. Fix claim() so the suffix counts up until an unused slug is found, without changing slugify() or the existing test in tests/slugify.test.js.
